segments.contextAfter: `value`: An instance to temporarily access through a mutable raw buffer pointer. Note that the `inout` exclusivity rules mean that, like any other `inout` argument, `value` cannot be directly accessed by other code for the duration of `body`. Access must only occur through the pointer argument to `body` until `body` returns.

segments.contextBefore: Parameters
segments.contextAfter: `body`: A closure that takes a raw buffer pointer to the bytes of `value` as its sole argument. If the closure has a return value, that value is also used as the return value of the `withUnsafeMutableBytes(of:_:)` function. The buffer pointer argument is valid only for the duration of the closure’s execution.
